authorization: Prospective additive software implementation and fixed correctness execution only after published native readiness and ownership. No scientific experiment, benchmark, sweep, solver invocation or historical PNEXT replay.
decision_changing_question: Can unchanged legacy prefix transcripts be checked for arithmetic soundness and projected-model completeness using the sparse cover utility, with the complete2^n certificate-exhaustion loop removed and without a trusted census?
positive_next_decision: If the independently executed fixed adapter checks pass, admit this exact verifier as a candidate verification interface for a later separately frozen solver experiment; no performance claim follows.
negative_next_decision: Retain the failing transcript and source/receipt; stop integration until an additive correction is admitted. Do not tune fixtures, rewrite old output or infer a mathematical obstruction.
inconclusive_next_decision: Preserve operational failure or untested joint as inconclusive; no blanket pass or repeat of historical science.

semantics.quantifiers: For each supplied finite n,m, canonical polynomial list and supported domain, validate every submitted proof/model before coverage. Conditional on validity, any actual domain root avoids every refuted cylinder; if their union with verified model-projection cylinders covers the domain, that root has a returned projection. Returned witnesses provide the opposite inclusion.
semantics.modulus: Generic arithmetic accepts canonical integer p>=2 and proves identities in (Z/p)[b]/(b_i^2-b_i); this identity implication does not require field primality. No primality certification is implemented. The EC wrapper requires p>3 and assumes mathematical primality externally.
semantics.polynomials: Each polynomial is a sparse mapping from squarefree masks to canonical nonzero integer coefficients1..p-1; empty mapping is zero. Masks are canonical Python ints excluding bool, or JSON decimal strings0/[1-9][0-9]*. Require0<=mask<2^n; reject alias collisions after decoding. Reject floats, negative/out-of-range masks, zero/noncanonical coefficients, malformed components. Generic API accepts already-decoded mappings and does not certify a raw JSON parser against duplicate identical textual keys.
semantics.certificates: Every learned record has canonical depth/prefix, exact LSB block clause, and one multiplier per original generator. Independently restrict each generator at the prefix, multiply squarefree monomials by bitwise OR, and verify sum(q_i*restricted_f_i)=1 modulo p exactly. Parse all multipliers and learned entries even if an earlier prefix already covers everything.
semantics.models: Every full packed assignment is a canonical int in0..2^n-1, satisfies the supported domain and all original polynomials. Project low m bits, reject any repeated projection even when distinct auxiliary values are supplied. One verified witness covers the full projection cylinder only for projected completeness; unverified assignments within that fiber need not be roots.
semantics.domain: aux_bound=None requires domain_cnf=[]. Otherwise0<=bound<=2^(n-m). Exact supported CNF has one full-width auxiliary-only clause, in increasing variable order, blocking each auxiliary value in[bound,2^(n-m)) once. Validate shape, decoded value>=bound, uniqueness and count2^(n-m)-bound; do not enumerate omitted assignments. Arbitrary/partial/mixed-projected CNF is unsupported and rejected.
semantics.status: For declared complete, cover_complete must be true or reject the claim. Declared censored remains censored and projected_model_set_complete false even if coverage independently closes. A gap is a noncovered Boolean assignment, not necessarily an arithmetic root.
semantics.wrapper: Validate canonical p,s,a,b,target, named arm quartic/membership/quadratic/quadratic_aa, nonzero target ordinate, nonsingular curve and2^s<=p before build. Use m=2s; no auxiliary bound for quartic/membership and bound=p for quadratic variants. Verify rational reconstruction and group sum for each submitted model projection. Prime premise remains explicit.

cost_ceiling.completeness_phase: No enumeration over2^n or2^m by operational verifier/adapter. Work follows supplied polynomial/proof terms, model witnesses, domain clauses and trie prefix lengths.
cost_ceiling.identity_work: Charge restriction term visits and every multiplier-term pair multiplication/addition in each checked identity; certificate size may itself be exponential.
cost_ceiling.range_and_cover_work: Charge each domain literal/entry and each supplied prefix. Trie has at most1+sum(depth) nodes; input/trie work O(number prefixes+sum depths), plus integer/input/output bit costs. Exact legacy CNF itself may be large.
phase_counters: supplied prefix count/depth sum and allocated trie nodes
cost_ceiling.construction_limit: Frozen membership build still constructs full truth tables. The wrapper may call it; record its construction cost separately. Only certificate-completeness checking avoids full-cube enumeration; no whole-pipeline nonenumeration or speedup claim.
cost_ceiling.ceiling: No shortcut to constructing certificates, finding solutions, validating general CNF, all full-model enumeration, degree-of-regularity reduction or ECDLP scalar recovery is claimed.

execution.allowed_execution: Only the fixed generic cases/mutations, fixed p5 four-arm compatibility cases, and direct old verify_search equivalence inside those suites. No additional standalone regression requiring solver calls. Construct no SAT solver object; a test guard may make all solver/refute/search entry points raise if called.

Producer may repair only additive unfrozen source before snapshot without changing fixtures; reviewer may repair only own harness. A frozen target defect stops independent execution for additive handling.
